title: Pierre the Pigeon-Hawk
overview: In New York City, Pierre, born as a product of forbidden love between a hawk and a pigeon, is rejected by both communities. Tired of not fitting in, Pierre sets out on a mission to discover where he truly belongs.

title: Sivka-Burka
overview: Ivan is the youngest son in the family, and everyone considers him a fool. When his old father died, Ivan, the only one of his three sons, fulfilled his request and visited his father's grave for three days. For this, the secret of the magic horse Sivka-Burka was revealed to him, which can make Ivan a wonderful young man. Meanwhile, the king decided to marry his princess daughter to the one who would kiss her, jumping to a high tower.

title: A Dog Named Palma 3
overview: At an aviation festival, the Lazarev family and their dog, Palma, cross paths with a talented orphan named Yura and his loyal companion—a stray dog ​​called Graf—who are being forced to commit thefts for a gang of criminals. After navigating a series of challenges and adventures, the Lazarevs and Palma decide to rescue Yura and Graf from the thieves, ultimately helping them find a family.

title: Alpine Ballad
overview: 1943. Soviet soldier Ivan escapes from a death camp in the Italian Alps. However, his plans are thwarted by two unexpected companions: the famous German film star Diter Shultse and the Italian anti-fascist Dzhuliya.

title: The Treasures of the Gnomes 2
overview: It would seem that the life of Roma, an unlucky businessman, is finally about to take a turn for the better—but the constant, demanding whims of four gnomes leave him no time for anything else. Everything changes, however, when Roma discovers a magic mirror in a dusty library and inadvertently sets free a gnome named Lovkarius. This new "business partner" offers Roma exactly what he has long dreamed of: a quest to find the mysterious cave of Ali Baba, which promises to free him from all his obligations. The path there, however, does not lead through airports or train stations, but rather through a series of "little pranks" that require theft and deception. While Roma—swayed by the smooth-talking gnome’s promises of untold riches and fame—flees to Dubai, his wife, Natasha, and daughter, Varya, set off in pursuit alongside the gnomes, determined to save Roma not only from the perils of the desert but also from himself.

title: Ум и Хрум: Сила пяти вкусов
overview: The brilliant scientist Um and his loyal friend Khrum live on a planet where everything is made of food. One day, they find themselves in a mysterious cave and accidentally awaken an ancient monster—the Tasteless One. His goal is to destroy all flavors, thereby stripping everyone of the joy of living. To save their world, Um and Khrum embark on a perilous journey in search of five legendary edible ingredients that can stop the Tasteless One.
